validity.researcher_notes: Existence and specs confirmed via EIA 28 releases (2018-05 through 2026-08): Gulf South Pipeline operator, Louisiana state, 16 mi, 30 inch diameter, 735 MMcf/d capacity, in-service 1997, status Completed. All sheet values match EIA exactly. FERC docket CP96-572 documented in EIA. No second independent origin found (FERC order text or state regulator approval order not accessed), but EIA is authoritative federal source with consistent historical record. Pipeline is real, correctly classified as transmission, not a duplicate (distinct from other Gulf South expansions P2561/P3194/P5926/P5932/P5939/P5968/P5969/P5974/P5975/P5976). Owner Boardwalk Pipeline Partners not independently verified but consistent with Gulf South's parent company. Status confirmed operating as of EIA Aug 2026 release (latest).

Owner Boardwalk Pipeline Partners recorded on sheet. EIA does not detail owner (only operator: Gulf South Pipeline). No independent source found to verify Boardwalk as current owner. Second source for owner not found; would require SEC filing, state regulator record, or company announcement. Recommend as future work.

Proposal date not recorded on sheet (blank cells). EIA does not carry proposal date. The project is historical (in-service 1997); proposal would have been in 1996 or earlier per FERC docket CP96-572, but specific proposal month/year not found in EIA. A FERC order or Federal Register notice would carry the proposal date, but those documents were not accessed. Since the pipeline is already completed and operating, proposal date is lower priority. Would require FERC CP96-572 order examination.

Construction date not recorded on sheet (blank cells). EIA does not carry construction start date (only in-service 1997). FERC CP96-572 would document construction commencement notice, but that order was not accessed. Given pipeline is operating since 1997, this is lower priority. Could be researched via FERC notice of commencement of service or state regulator filings.

MAOP/pressure not recorded on sheet (blank). EIA does not carry pressure data. Would require access to FERC final order with design specs or PHMSA/NPMS records. Not found in web search. Lower priority for an operating line.

FuelSource not recorded on sheet (blank). This appears to be a supply-origin field (e.g., Haynesville, Marcellus, etc.). Bastian Bay Extension in Louisiana could source from multiple fields (Haynesville, Mississippi Lime, other Gulf formations). No single source pinpoints fuel source for this specific segment. Would require Gulf South disclosure or SEC filing. Recommend open question.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Current status operating confirmed. EIA Aug 2026 release (most recent, dated 2026-08) shows GS Bastian Bay Extension in Historical Projects (1996-2024) sheet as status Completed. This status consistent across all 28 releases from 2018-05 onward. No evidence of abandonment, idling, conversion, sale/rename, or status change found. The pipeline has been operating continuously since in-service 1997. Sheet's LastUpdated is 2025-09-18, which is within acceptable current range. No independent news of operational changes found. Verdict: still operating as recorded.

summary: P5967 GS Bastian Bay Extension confirmed real, operating transmission gas pipeline in Louisiana via EIA (28 releases 2018-05 through 2026-08). All specs verified: 16 mi, 30 inch, 735 MMcf/d, in-service 1997, $20.5M cost. Operator Gulf South Pipeline sourced. Owner Boardwalk Pipeline Partners not independently verified. Status review confirms pipeline still operating. 15 worklist units covered: 4 REVERIFIED (Status/Fuel/Type/primary refs live-checked), 7 REFS_ADDED (specs, location, cost, operator), 4 UNRESOLVED (Proposal, Construction, Pressure, FuelSource), no HAS_REF units downgraded. Second independent source (FERC order, state regulator) not accessed but EIA is authoritative federal source with perfect historical consistency. No concerns.
